description:
🔴 **The Android target has never been compiled by anything.** There is no `build.gradle`, so — exactly as with iOS before 2026-08-20 — *"it does not compile"* is not a statement about the code. There is no project to compile, and no compiler has ever read these 16 Kotlin files.

**Adding the manifest is the smaller half.** Four symbols are referenced and never written, so the build will fail immediately even once it can run:

- **`AmphoraGraph`** — the DI graph, referenced from `AmphoraUploader.kt:55`, `UploadWorker.kt:29` and `UploadWorker.kt:63`. Nothing constructs the engine without it.
- **`EnumConverters`** — `@TypeConverters(EnumConverters::class)` on `UploadDatabase.kt:14`; Room will not generate a DAO without it.
- **`UploadWorker.enqueueDelayed`** — called from `DefaultUploadEngine.kt:116` to schedule the `RETRY_WAIT` wake-up. Without it there is no backoff path at all.
- **`deps.notifications.foregroundInfo(job)`** — `UploadWorker.kt:41`; a `dataSync` foreground service cannot start without a notification.

**The iOS precedent is the warning.** Adding that manifest surfaced five genuine defects that had been invisible — three redundant optional re-bindings and two actor-isolation violations. Expect the same here and budget for it: the first real compile of 16 unchecked files is a discovery, not a formality.

userStories.title: The Android library has a build manifest and Gradle can see it
userStories.description: A Gradle Android library module with the Room, WorkManager and coroutines dependencies the existing sources already import.
acceptanceCriteria: `./gradlew :android:assemble` (or the project's equivalent) runs and reaches the Kotlin compiler.
Every dependency the existing sources import is declared — no source is edited to dodge a missing dependency.
The minSdk/targetSdk chosen are stated with a reason, and the reason references the Android 15 `dataSync` budget the design is built around.
The JDK and Android SDK versions required are written down, because neither is installed on the authoring machine.
userStories.notes: Gradle manifest and dependency declarations added; AndroidManifest.xml parses cleanly and git diff --check is clean. The authoring machine has no JDK, Android SDK, or Gradle, so :android:assemble could not run here (gradle: command not found); CI requires JDK 17, SDK Platform 35, and Gradle 8.7+.

userStories.title: The four unwritten symbols exist
userStories.description: Write AmphoraGraph, EnumConverters, UploadWorker.enqueueDelayed and the notification builder against their existing call sites. The call sites are the specification — do not change them to suit a convenient implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: `AmphoraGraph.of(context)` returns a graph exposing at least `uploader` and `notifications`, satisfying all three existing call sites unmodified.
`EnumConverters` covers every enum persisted by `UploadJob`, and Room's annotation processor generates the DAO without error.
`UploadWorker.enqueueDelayed(context, jobId, delayMillis)` schedules a wake-up matching the `RETRY_WAIT` semantics in `docs/reference/state-machine.md`.
The notification builder returns a `ForegroundInfo` valid for a `dataSync` foreground service.
No existing call site was edited to accommodate the new code.

userStories.title: The target compiles clean, and whatever that surfaces is fixed
userStories.description: Zero errors. Treat warnings the way the iOS pass did — fix them rather than bank them.
acceptanceCriteria: A clean build reports zero errors.
Any defect the first compile surfaces is FIXED, and each is named in the tasklist notes with its cause — not silenced with a suppression or a cast.
`README.md`'s status section is corrected: it currently says the Android target cannot compile.
